# Read EWS MIME content as bytes before base64 encoding it

1108 copies file content as Vec<u8> into MIME base64, while the outgoing-send path separately converts content to UTF-8. Saving an existing message must not inherit the sender's text conversion assumption. The accepted create-message request still encodes the byte vector directly and sets SaveOnly with an explicit destination folder ID. Keep this byte boundary when changing file-copy input. No non-UTF-8 message was uploaded in this study.

Scope: EWS binary MIME save boundary.
